男孩最爱-奈飞出品 少儿英语启蒙动画（小小火车向前冲）go go ！Cory Carson<br>
<img id="aimg_MAo7q" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091622_366_610e1399fde5a.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091622_366_610e1399fde5a.png"><br>
<font color="#09408e">《Go! Go! Cory Carson》是一部面向学龄前儿童的动画片，由加利福尼亞州伯克利的 Kuku Studios 制作。</font><br>
<font color="#09408e">由亞曆克斯·吴（《机器人总动员》《美食总动员》）、斯坦利·穆尔（《海底总动员 2：多莉去哪儿》《怪兽大学》）和托恩·蒂内（《Wonder Pets!》《The Adventures of Napkin Man!》）擔任監制。</font><br>
<font color="#09408e">柯利（Cory）是一款带有趣味性发动机的小孩车。他顽皮的精神通常会使他在旅途中充满挑战性和娱乐性。</font><br>
<img id="aimg_HeE1E" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091434_534_f75e8bb009bb2.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091434_534_f75e8bb009bb2.png"><br>
<font color="#9408e">Cory和他的家人住在Bumperton Hills镇上，那里总是有有趣的人要跟他聊天，而另一场冒险就在路上。</font><br>
<img id="aimg_PBq0U" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091844_052_2281d3edeabe3.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091844_052_2281d3edeabe3.png"><br>
<font color="#9408e">Cory和我们的宝宝们一样，有点爱睡懒觉</font><br>
<img id="aimg_W9Hot" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091854_264_0aebf78d2f487.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091854_264_0aebf78d2f487.png"><br>
<font color="#09408e">Cory 同样有着玩气球的各种惨痛的经历</font><br>
<img id="aimg_acsq6" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091904_586_c9da900676127.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091904_586_c9da900676127.png"><br>
<img id="aimg_N3gGF" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091913_762_903a109561d67.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091913_762_903a109561d67.png"><br>
<img id="aimg_j7c04" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091922_450_ffda195521357.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091922_450_ffda195521357.png"><br>
<font color="#09408e">但Cory 特别疼爱照顾他的妹妹，深知妹妹爱玩气球，当气球 被风吹走后，他跟着气球，跑遍了整个小镇，把气球给追回来，累的他到家就睡着了。</font><br>
<img id="aimg_Z020t" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091927_962_446288b5e3cb5.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091927_962_446288b5e3cb5.png"><br>
<img id="aimg_hc11L" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091935_063_9057573ae8c82.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091935_063_9057573ae8c82.png"><br>
<img id="aimg_Z9ItO" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="517" height="295" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091940_972_348c3b1615c04.png" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091940_972_348c3b1615c04.png"><br>
<font color="#09408e">动画片不仅仅体现了Cory的冒险精神，细节中处处体现了兄妹之间的爱，父母与孩子们之间的爱，同学们之间的爱。</font><br>
<img id="aimg_sB6z8" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091947_402_84a8c6a24355c.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091947_402_84a8c6a24355c.png"><br>
<font color="#09408e">除此之外，动画片中还体现了父母虽对孩子们充满了爱，但绝不溺爱。培养孩子们的独立性，更懂得尊重孩子们的选择。</font><br>
<img id="aimg_R47OZ" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091957_120_3d529064c7d26.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://pic2.ziyuan.wang/user/turin1984/2025/11/wechat_2025-11-21_091957_120_3d529064c7d26.png"><br>
